name: ZAP active scan (lab application only)
description: Spider + passive scan + ZAP active scan rules (injection probes). Only runs when the approved system explicitly allows the 'zap-active' tool — intended for OWASP Juice Shop in the lab.

mapping_evidence.note: Stock Wazuh 4.14.9 rule 31151 (0245-web_rules.xml, level 10, T1595.002: multiple web server 400 errors from the same source IP) fired on agent 002 (lab-web-01 nginx access log) 42 s after the real ZAP 2.16.1 active scan of Juice Shop started (547 ZAP findings). SQL-injection rules 31103/31164/31152 (T1190) also fired but belong to a different technique and are not expected rules for this test.
